\section*{Data Availability}\label{sec:data}
The replication package is publicly available~\cite{repo_safe_coordination_untrusted_agents}; the revision is tagged \texttt{tse-r1}, and an archival snapshot with a persistent identifier will be deposited on Zenodo upon acceptance. It contains the TLA$^+$ specifications, refinement module and proofs; the reference controller (\texttt{src/vgc/controller.py}) and the generic kernel (\texttt{src/vgc/graph.py}); the scenario definitions and traces; all campaign drivers (\texttt{experiments/tse\_campaign.py}, \texttt{graph\_experiments.py}, \texttt{llm\_study.py}, \texttt{benchmark\_study.py}, \texttt{scripts/run\_models\_extended.py}); every model call made in RQ5 and RQ6 with its full response, token counts and latency; the cluster scripts (\texttt{hpc/}); and the scripts that generate every table, plot and number in this paper (\texttt{experiments/tse\_paper.py}, \texttt{experiments/revision\_paper.py}), with raw logs, exact commands, tool versions, model digests and source hashes.

\section*{Declaration on the Use of AI}
Generative AI tools were used to assist with organizing the repository code, drafting experiment scripts and checking the manuscript for grammatical errors. Language models are also the \emph{subjects} of RQ5 and RQ6, where they act as the untrusted proposers being coordinated. The author reviewed all generated material and takes full responsibility for the accuracy and integrity of all claims, proofs, references and the final manuscript.
